The '''Dustig system''' was a part of the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Dustig Trace]] as well as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Dustig Pocket]] enclave of what was historically known as [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dustig [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-16.<ref name="TEA" />
